mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT v.object_key FROM kb_document_version v JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = v.doc_id WHERE d.status <> 'deleted' AND v.object_key IN #{objectKey} UNION SELECT a.object_key FROM kb_document_import_attempt a WHERE a.state = 'ACTIVE' AND a.object_key IN #{objectKey}

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kb_document_version v JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = v.doc_id WHERE d.status <> 'deleted' LIMIT 1 ) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_document_import_attempt WHERE state = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1)
SELECT v.object_key FROM kb_document_version v JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = v.doc_id WHERE d.status <> 'deleted' ORDER BY v.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
